acceptance: Live repository identity is BenchBox-dev/theseus; intended visibility and license have owner approval; branch and review policies have recorded owner-approved settings.

Source inventory has a path-by-path seed mapping from the named BenchBox baseline, normalized diff, notices, and initial source hash; independent reviewer and final approved head are required before first promotion.
Owner full-diff review governs bootstrap merges; fork PRs and candidate builds cannot access App credentials, tailnet credentials, trusted publisher credentials, or a secret-bearing environment.
CI can build the seed offline from gateway credentials and reports genuine package failures rather than fake/no-op success; repository changes are merged under its approved governance.
context:
T2. Owner must perform settings/creation operations when permissions or explicit service authorization are unavailable. Package name plan: distribution theseus-reviewer; import theseus_reviewer; CLI theseus. Do not claim the repository exists until checked.

Live prerequisite check: gh api repos/BenchBox-dev/theseus returned HTTP 404 with the current credentials. This proves neither existence nor absence (private/inaccessible can also return 404). Owner must create or grant access to the named repository and approve bootstrap license/visibility/settings before this task can proceed. Do not silently choose a different owner/repository. No repository or settings were created/changed.
description:
Create or reconcile BenchBox-dev/theseus, using main as its configurable gated default branch. Deliver license compatible with extracted code and dependencies, contributor/security/release docs, CODEOWNERS, CI, and the source seed described by the ADR. Before adding source, record the BenchBox commit and complete path map; retain notices and establish redistribution rights. Capture an initial normalized tree diff and source hash for the later independent bootstrap review. Until a separately authenticated Theseus oracle gate is live, only owner full-diff-reviewed merges are allowed.
Decision gates: repository creation/visibility/license, protection settings, and any unavailable owner permission must be explicitly resolved by the owner; do not weaken protection to bootstrap.
Guardrails: no BenchBox code removal; no default-branch direct push; no copied private tracker/session data or secrets; no unreviewed template pin; no production deployment or live gateway changes. Use independent worktrees and narrow PRs for both named repositories. Preserve protocol/status/artifact identifiers; App identity is consumer config.
